	<ResortReportHeadline>Guns blazing after the Storm!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>If you were out on the hill yesterday, I hope you had heaps of fun. It sure was nice to feel some soft dry snow underfoot.</p><p>As forecast, snowfalls have eased. There's been a further 5cms recorded in the 24hr period with most of that falling during the day yesterday. At the moment there's just a very light fog in the Village but I can also see the moon and some stars. The current temp is a chilly -4.2 degrees and we're headed for a top of 1 degree. The wind has swung around to the South and is currently moderate at 30km/h which may ease further as the day progresses.</p><p>With favourable conditions the guns have been going full noise all night and they're still blazing away as I type. With the combination of new snow, cold temps and snowmaking I reckon the open groomed terrain will be in tip top shape this morning perfect for laying your edges over.</p><p>While the coverage on HV has improved, take care and observe all rope lines and signage. There are still many obstacles and some runs have been upgraded in difficulty. The Extreme Area remains closed so please stay away.</p><p>Enjoy another day of great mid-winter like snow!</p><p>Cheers, Burner.</p><p><br></p></ResortReport>
